summary: Delta-gated doc audits: /fx-doc audit/update spawn a module-auditor only for modules with changed sources or unfilled stubs, decided from a cheap per-doc git-log gate (each doc against its own last_reviewed_commit) over a docs-meta/.fenix-cache.json frontmatter index. Diff-scoped staleness, cache-backed freshness-scanner, --only/--all/--rebuild-cache/--suggest-drawers/--stubs-only flags. setup.sh's manifest and upgrade writes now pass values through the environment (no Python-source interpolation) and fail loudly instead of swallowing errors.
notes: docs-meta/.fenix-cache.json is NOT shipped — it is generated by the orchestrator on the first /fx-doc run (or via /fx-doc audit --rebuild-cache) and recorded in the manifest as a `create` action, so /fx-uninstall removes it.

CLAUDE.md and docs/DISCLAIMER.md are preserved (user-editable). Their version banners ('P-3 (Fenix) v3.1.0') are cosmetic and will keep reading 3.1.0 after upgrade — bump them by hand if you want, or compare against the kit's templates/CLAUDE.md and templates/DISCLAIMER.md.
No agent definitions other than module-auditor changed in 3.2.0; the gating logic lives in fx-doc.md (the orchestrator), which is why the replace list is small.
